title: Naturally Peppery Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A festive Australian dish featuring coriander leaves and score-fat lamb, perfect for a dairy-free friendly meal. The peppery flavor and springy texture make it a great option for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, aiming for an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chopped coriander leaves to the bowl and stir to combine.
Thread the scored lamb shoulder onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb skewers with the marinade, making sure they are fully coated.
Grill the lamb skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach the desired level of doneness.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb skewers on a lazy-susan-spinner, garnished with additional coriander leaves if desired.
